arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
sahihInternational: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
yusufAli: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
urdu: اور ہمارا تم پر کچھ زور نہ تھا۔ بلکہ تم سرکش لوگ تھے

sahihInternational: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
yusufAli: Yea, such! but - for the wrong-doers will be an evil place of (Final) Return!-
urdu: یہ (نعمتیں تو فرمانبرداروں کے لئے ہیں) اور سرکشوں کے لئے برا ٹھکانا ہے

arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
sahihInternational: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
yusufAli: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
urdu: کیا یہ کہ ایک دوسرے کو اسی بات کی وصیت کرتے آئے ہیں بلکہ یہ شریر لوگ ہیں

arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
sahihInternational: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
yusufAli: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds?
urdu: کیا ان کی عقلیں ان کو یہی سکھاتی ہیں۔ بلکہ یہ لوگ ہیں ہی شریر

sahihInternational: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
yusufAli: They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed!
urdu: کہنے لگے ہائے شامت ہم ہی حد سے بڑھ گئے تھے

sahihInternational: For the transgressors, a place of return,
yusufAli: For the transgressors a place of destination:
